english.title: Election agent/candidate fail to accompany expenses return with declaration
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of an illegal practice in that,

(A)_[being an election agent for a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), in an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..),you failed to comply with the requirement that a return delivered under section 81(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983 be accompanied by a declaration made by you in the appropriate form]_
(B)_[being a candidate in an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..), you failed to comply with the requirement that you deliver a declaration made by you in the appropriate form at the same time that the election agent delivered a return under section 81(1) of the Representation of the People Act 1983 or within seven days afterwards]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 82, 84 and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
